div.head: II Cn 25a
div.ab: Gif he þonne ne mage, gewylde man hine, swa hwæðer swa man mæge, swa cucne swa deadne, ⁊ niman eall þæt he ahte.
Gif he ne mage, þonne gewylde man hine, swa hwæðer man mage, swa cucne swa deadne, ⁊ niman eall þæt he age.
Si non possit, exuperetur, sicut alterutrum poterit, siue uiuus siue mortuus, et capiatur omne quod habebit.
Gyf he ðonne ne mæge, gewylde man hine swa hwæðer swa man mæge, swa cwicne swa deadne, ⁊ nimen eall þæt he ah.
Gif he þonne ne mage, gewylde man hine swa hwæðer swa man mæge, swa cucne swa deadne, and niman eall þæt he ahte.
Wenn er [dies] aber nicht kann, (dann A) bemächtige man sich seiner, wie man kann, entweder lebend oder todt; und sie sollen alles was er hat(te G) fortnehmen.
But if he cannot [do this], (then, A) let him be overpowered however one can, alive or dead; and let them take everything he has (had, G).
If, however, he cannot [do so], they shall seize him as they can, either alive or dead, and they shall take all that he has.
If he cannot do so, they are to capture him however they can, either alive or dead, and seize all that he owns.
div.note: A and Ld's ‘age’ is better than G's ‘ahte’ (compare III Eg 7.1). Liebermann compares III Eg 7.1.
